description: Return HTTP requests captured from the connected tab — method, URL, resource type, status, transferred size, duration, initiator, and failure reason. Capture starts when this server connects to the tab: requests issued before that are NOT visible (unlike get_console_logs, which replays pre-connect history). Requests belonging to a previous page are pruned on navigation, mirroring the DevTools Network panel default; the new document request itself is kept. A redirect chain appears as one record per hop, sharing a requestId and distinguished by `hop`. WebSocket frames are not captured. In a bulk listing, a URL ending in `…` is truncated and not usable — query its `requestId` for it in full. `size` is compressed on-the-wire bytes; `canceled` marks an abort (e.g. navigating away), usually not a real failure.

headerKeys.description: Return only these headers, matched case-insensitively, on both requestHeaders and responseHeaders. Omit to return no headers. Pass ["*"] for every header — that is bounded only by `limit`, so use it with `requestId` or a small limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of most-recent requests to return

requestId.description: Return only this request, including every hop of its redirect chain. Pair with headerKeys to inspect one request in full.

resourceType.description: Filter by CDP resource type. Any casing is accepted.

status.description: Filter by response status class, or by outcome: `failed` = network error/blocked, `pending` = still in flight.

urlFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the full (untruncated) request URL

name: get_network_requests

canceled.description: The failure was a cancellation (navigating away, an aborted fetch), not a genuine network error — usually not worth reporting as a problem

durationMs.description: Milliseconds from request start until this hop was closed out — by loadingFinished, loadingFailed, or the next hop taking over on a redirect

errorText.description: CDP failure or block reason (e.g. `net::ERR_ABORTED`); present only when state is `failed`

fromCache.description: Served from Chrome cache rather than the network; `size` is then typically 0

hop.description: Redirect hop index; omitted for the first hop

initiator.description: Flattened to "<type> <url>:<line>", or just the type when no location is known. Compiled position, not source-mapped; capped at 200 chars.

redirectedTo.description: Redirect target from the `Location` header; same truncation rules as `url`

requestHeaders.description: The headers named by `headerKeys`, keyed by your own spelling; absent when `headerKeys` is omitted. A requested header missing from this map was not sent; one present with an empty string WAS sent, with an empty value.

resourceType.description: CDP resource type (Document, Script, XHR, …); same vocabulary as the `resourceType` filter

responseHeaders.description: Same projection as `requestHeaders`; `{}` when no response arrived

size.description: Transferred on-the-wire bytes (encodedDataLength) — compressed, not the decoded body size

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 wall-clock time the request was sent

state.description: Lifecycle of this hop: `pending` = no terminal event yet (stays pending forever if the page navigated away mid-flight), `complete` = loaded, `failed` = network error or blocked, `redirect` = returned 3xx and continued on the next hop.

status.description: HTTP status of this hop — the 3xx itself when state is `redirect`. Absent until a response arrives.

statusText.description: Reason phrase; usually absent over HTTP/2+, which has none

url.description: data: URIs are always collapsed; in a bulk listing long URLs are truncated too. Both are marked with `…`, and a marked value is NOT a usable URL — query a single `requestId` to get long URLs in full. `urlFilter` always matches the full URL.
